title: Resolution to set hearing on raising BID spending limits
summary: This resolution schedules a public hearing on proposed increases to the annual spending caps of eight business improvement districts, including 34th Street, 82nd Street and East Mid-Manhattan, starting July 1, 2027. Proposed new annual limits range from $354,450 for the 82nd Street district to $16.3 million for the 34th Street district. The hearing will be held in the City Council Committee Room at City Hall, with the date and time to be filled in.
